bio: This restaurant in the Carlstadt district is a masterclass in chic: shimmering gold, velvet, striking chandeliers and stylish Art Deco features create a trendy, elegant atmosphere. It serves up flavourful, well-executed dishes from a menu featuring French brasserie classics as well as Italian influences: beef bourguignon, beef tartare, pasta, vitello al limone... Service is professional and friendly. Head there in the evening for the cocktail bar and DJs, who underscore the Parisian club vibe....
